title: Replication package for "Recognition as Eligibility: County-Seat Proximity and Access to Conservation Support Arrangements in China's Traditional Villages"
description: Replication package for a study of the 2016 fourth cohort of China's Traditional Villages. The fourth-cohort villages share a common national designation status and therefore a common formal eligibility for centrally financed conservation support; the study asks whether the timing of entry into the first announced support schedule is associated with a village's distance from its county government seat. The package contains all data-construction, matching, adjudication, variable, estimation, diagnostic, verification and typesetting scripts, the coordinate-free derived datasets needed to reproduce every reported number, the frozen result logs, the adjudication and provenance registers, and the two manuscript figures. Village coordinates are not redistributed: they originate from the Spatial Distribution Dataset of 1,598 Newly Added Traditional Villages in China (DOI 10.3974/geodb.2019.01.19.V1) under terms that restrict redistribution. Obtaining that dataset and running the included scripts regenerates every geographical variable.
